name: Twenty One Pilots: Festivals 2026 Series
overview: Twenty One Pilots: Festivals 2026 Series is a documentary web series following Twenty One Pilots throughout their 2026 festival run. The series captures Tyler Joseph and Josh Dun's live performances, backstage moments, and life on the road as they perform at major music festivals following the Breach era.
